issue.title: orders-gateway RSS grows until OOM every ~2 days
issue.body: Since the 2026.09.02 deploy, RSS on orders-gateway pods climbs steadily from ~350 MB to the 2 GiB limit and the pod gets OOMKilled roughly every two days. Before that deploy memory was flat. Traffic is unchanged. Heap snapshot diff (6h apart) attached: top retainer growth is a `Map` inside `RequestContextCache` (+410k entries), then `Socket` objects (+2k, stable after the first hour). We rolled one canary pod back to 2026.08.26 and it stays flat.

deploy_2026_09_02_changes: Add per-request context cache for tracing headers
